name: recordings_visual_identity_retry
title: Retry a saved image answer’s picture update
description: Retries only native application of the current saved image answer. Preserves the answer and starts no recognition, transcription or render provider work. Existing pending work is reused, and the result returns status and a recovery action.

already_applied.description: True when the call returned the existing decision rather than recording a new one.

speaker_model_context.description: Compact speaker identity context shared with the model; the full speaker evidence stays in result metadata.
